name: chart-line-02
title: chart-line-02
description: Subscriber growth · year over year. June subscribers compared with the same month last year.

meta.prompt:
Create a responsive analytics card titled “A stronger first half” with the muted eyebrow “Subscriber growth · year over year”. Fill available width up to 576px. Use a theme-aware card surface, rounded border, an 18px title, a prominent 30px semibold metric with tabular numerals, and a separated muted footer.

Compare Jan–Jun subscriber counts: This year at 186, 225, 208, 284, 312, 368 as a solid 3px line with 4px dots; Last year at 140, 178, 190, 210, 245, 272 as a dashed 2px line without dots. Use distinct colors and a legend. Show +35.3% and explain the June year-over-year comparison in the footer.

Keep the plot 260px tall and responsive to the card width. Provide accessible chart navigation and value tooltips. Use Jan–Jun month labels, a numeric vertical axis, dashed horizontal grid lines, and clean axes without tick marks or axis lines.
